syllabus_title: WAEC SSCE / WASSCE Textiles Detailed Syllabus

topics.topic: Competencies, attitudes and behaviour of the students for employment
Fibre processing e.g. soaking, ginning, etc.
Point paper designing: Plain, twill, satin/sateen and variations
Looms and accessories: types of loom (man power, traditional, broad loom and power looms e.g. shuttle and shuttleless loom and accessories)
Textile calculations: weight/cost of warp, weft and fabric
Weaving: Processes (traditional and broad loom) i.e. warping, beaming, heddling, reeding, tying up, bobbin winding, etc. Loom motions (Primary, secondary and Auxiliary motion)
Other fabric construction processes i.e. knitting, crocheting and tapestry
Preparation, care and maintenance of tools, materials and equipment
Basic drawings i.e. using elements and principles of design
Usage of indigenous colour schemes, ideas, symbols and cultural motifs for designing
Decorative techniques: dyeing, printing, appliqué and embroidery processes
Types of finishing techniques: mechanical, chemical
Challenges and interventions in managing resources, marketing and distribution
Types of portfolios: hard and soft copy portfolios
Meaning, types, purpose and processes of mounting exhibitions
Key points of a business plan
Costing, pricing and marketing of textile products
